name: claude-code-fuel-gauge
description: Live context %, cache countdown, model·effort and usage limits for Claude Code — in your VS Code status bar.

fuel-gauge.pollInterval.description: How often to check for context updates (in seconds)

fuel-gauge.warningThreshold.description: Percentage at which the indicator turns yellow

fuel-gauge.dangerThreshold.description: Percentage at which the indicator turns red

fuel-gauge.systemOverhead.description: Estimated system token overhead (system prompt, tools, MCP, CLAUDE.md). These tokens are invisible to the statusline but consume context. Increase if Fuel Gauge underreports compared to Claude Code's 'Context low' warning.

fuel-gauge.cacheTTL.description: Prompt-cache TTL in seconds. Leave null to auto-detect from cache behavior. Common values: 300 (5 min, Pro/API), 3600 (1 hour, Max main agent).

fuel-gauge.cacheWarningSeconds.description: Play 3 short beeps when the cache countdown drops below this threshold (in seconds). Leave null to disable. macOS only (uses afplay). Example: 180 for a 3-minute warning.

fuel-gauge.effortStyle.description: Show the active model + reasoning-effort level as a compact status bar item (e.g. 'opus·x-high'), color-coded by effort level (low → medium → high → x-high → max). 'text' = show it, 'off' = hide it. The effort part only appears when the current Claude Code model exposes an effort level; hover for the full model / effort / context / cache breakdown.

fuel-gauge.showUsage.description: Show your Claude plan's usage limits — session (5-hour) and weekly percentage used, with reset times — in the fuel-gauge hover tooltip. When a limit gets high, a colored alert dot appears in the status bar (yellow at 70% used, red at 90%). Only available on subscription plans (Pro/Max), once Claude Code reports limit data.
